content.text:
We will carry out a full bathroom refurbishment in the upstairs bathroom, stripping out the existing suite and installing a new bath with shower over, basin and pedestal, and toilet, all of which you will be supplying. We will also fit a replacement heated towel rail, tile approximately 14m² of walls, and make good on completion. Decorating is not included in this scope of work.

Please note that the condition of the soil stack cannot be assessed until the existing fittings are removed; if remedial work is required, this will be treated as a provisional sum and agreed with you before proceeding. It would also be worth confirming in advance that your bathroom suite and wall tiles will be on site and ready before work begins.
